data.name: Bloody Hype
data.detailed_description:
This is not just a game, this is a sober drill for the viral age.

  • "If something is popular enough, it will seem more true than itself."

  • "The more innocent people are, the more suitable they are for making topics."

  • "You can have no self, but you can't have no persona."

These are not lines, but the reality unfolding every day in the viral age.
In today's world, the most dangerous weapons are not just guns and knives, but public opinion.

What we want to do is lay it all bare and complete before you in a way you can experience firsthand.
Produced by a professional team of cinematic level, it tells fictional stories and reflects real human nature.
This era never lacks onlookers, what it lacks is people who are still willing to speak out after seeing everything.

We made this game because we believe: the more people see, the less room the manipulators behind public opinion have to act recklessly.
Dedicated to everyone who refuses to be tamed by viral traffic.

When viral traffic becomes a weapon, are you the manipulator or the sacrifice?

A carefully planned "rape case" sends an ordinary young man with no background to the abyss. A woman who rises to power on your bones and blood harvests gender viral traffic wantonly, under the banner of feminism, becoming a "feminist fighter" praised by the whole internet. Long prison terms and repeated cyberbullying destroy everything you have — your lover fades, your family suffers. When you confront her in despair, you are met with murder. Fed by viral traffic, she has transformed into a bloodthirsty monster.

But the abyss did not swallow you. With the rage of escaping death, you step into a life-and-death battle royale with viral traffic as chips, fueled by a mysterious organization. As the bottom line is constantly broken, the game spirals out of control — "Killing brings viral traffic, death gets rewards". The carnival in front of the screen eventually turns into a bloodthirsty feast... And the organizer hiding behind the scenes is weaving a huge dark web through this carnival, revealing an even more terrifying ambition.

Will you be the manipulator, or reduced to a sacrifice?

Exclusive viral gameplay, turning you from an onlooker into a player.

  • Viral Point Collection

Negotiate with various characters, dig out hidden events, and collect impactful "viral point" materials. These fragments are not only pieces of the truth, but also ammunition for controlling public opinion later.

  • Viral Manipulation

Experience viral gameplay firsthand. Collage and typeset materials to create content that sweeps the internet. Deep interactive gameplay, dismantle the golden rules of viral traffic, and experience real behind-the-scenes manipulation.

  • Multi-dimensional Stats

In addition to the thrilling "Affection", there is the unfathomable "Moral Value", and a real-time "Viral Ranking". Ruthless or conscientious, the stats intuitively determine how far you can go at the peak of power.

  • Girlfriend System

Untamable archenemies, scheming confidants, allies with a smile hidden knife... In this viral hunting ground, trust is a chip, betrayal is the norm. Will you choose to understand them, or use them?

  • Story Branching

Rejects the outdated "wrong choice = death" routine. Every choice not only determines the story direction, but also quietly affects complex stat changes, reshaping you every step of the way. Plenty of endings unfold before you: Will you successfully revenge and escape unscathed? Or will you be ruined and sink together? The dice of fate have been cast into your hands.

They each have their own origins and their own secrets.

Step into this life-and-death puzzle, six women with distinct styles await you in the depths of fate.
You can find a home in Bai Keke's almost life-threatening infatuation, or try to tame Lin Youyou's untamable little cat;
You can feel the burning sincerity under Lin Ruotao's stubborn appearance, or personally uncover the shy and touching blush behind Lu Ya's mask.


If you crave stability, Meng Xiaobai's gentleness and company are enough to heal your pain; if you prefer danger, approach Ai Moli step by step, tear off her carefully disguised true face, until you watch this gorgeous poisonous snake have no way out in your strategy.And these six women are just the tip of the iceberg in this puzzle. More characters with unknown identities and distinct personalities are lurking in the depths of the story, waiting for you to discover them personally.

data.short_description: You'll grow from a helpless viral victim to an all-powerful god of public opinion. When you finally hold power and beauty, facing this world that feeds on human suffering, will you become a cog in the viral machine, or the blade that cuts through the rules? The choice is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics / GeForce GTX 960 / Radeon R9 285
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur 11
  • Processor: Intel or Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

  • OS: macOS Sequoia 15
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel i7

  • Storage: 40 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some pornographic content (such as provocative language and partial body nudity), some violent content (such as verbal violence, very few bloody or thrilling scenes), and a small amount of alcohol abuse scenes, so it is not suitable for players of all ages.
